note: Every skip needs a written reason. A suite that quietly runs a subset reports success exactly like one that runs all of them.

skips.reason: n8n community nodes are forbidden from reading environment variables (verification rule: nodes must not interact with env vars or read/write files), so LABELZOOM_API_KEY cannot be a credential source. The node's only source of a key is its credential, which request/auth-present covers. The companion rule this case pairs with — an explicitly empty credential must NOT fall back to the environment — is still asserted by request/auth-empty-string-forces-anonymous, which passes.
